touches.text: it launches a script in each device's cairn/devices/<device>/groundloop called pulse.py, each as its own process.
It writes one JSON record at the end of a pass with a list of each device: beat time, found device (folder), NOT FOUND or name, file mtime, pid it spawned. It does no checks and no takeover.

open_questions.text: The bus process and the device processes also stay up. I read "daemon" here as "the only thing that wakes on a clock"; everything else wakes on an event. Right?
Beat interval: 60 s today. Fixed, or a setting?
